question: What protection is claimed for the body even in the case of being bitten by great serpents?
premises: A negation states that poison does not enter.
This holds even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
inference: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: The basis for this protection is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
